'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
****[[August 2021 Kabul attack]]
*****[[Taliban]] gunmen and a [[suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]]er attack [[Kabul]]. Thirteen people, including five attackers, are killed. [https://independent.co.uk/asia/taliban-kabul-attack-afghanistan-tactics-b1896577.html (''The Independent'')] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei]]
*****[[China|Chinese]] [[Government of the People's Republic of China|authorities]] announce city-wide [[COVID-19 testing]] for 11 million people in [[Wuhan]] after the first locally transmitted cases since May 2020 were reported in the city, where three cases that had been found were of the highly-transmissible [[SARS-CoV-2 lineage B.1.617|Lineage B.1.617]] [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2021/08/03/wuhan-test-entire-11-million-population-amid-spike-delta-variant/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 39,019 new cases of [[COVID-19]], thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 3.979 million. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/iran-reports-another-daily-high-in-new-covid-cases/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] surpasses one million daily [[COVID-19 vaccination]] doses for the first time after the [[Government of Pakistan|government]] warned that it may ban unvaccinated people from entering some public places and using some forms of transportation. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/pakistan-reaches-1-million-covid-19-shots-a-day-after-warning-unvaccinated-face (''The Straits Times'')]   
****[[Islamabad]] becomes the first city in Pakistan with a population of more than one million people to have 50% of its eligible population vaccinated with at least one dose of a COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.dawn.com/news/amp/1638543 (''Dawn'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports its first two cases of the Delta Plus variant in a man who had not travelled internationally and a person who had travelled from the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|United States]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20210803002251320 (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Louisiana]]
****[[Louisiana]] reports a record 2,112 hospitalizations from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/louisiana/articles/2021-08-03/louisiana-breaks-record-for-covid-19-hospitalizations (U.S. News & World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
*****[[Mayor of New York City|New York City Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] announces that the city will issue a [[COVID-19 vaccine mandates in the United States|vaccine mandate]] for indoor dining, gyms, and public performances, making [[New York City]] the first U.S. city to do so. The program will begin on August 16 and will be enforceable beginning on September 13. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/08/03/nyregion/nyc-vaccine-mandate.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Utah]]
****[[Governor of Utah|Utah Governor]] [[Spencer Cox (politician)|Spencer Cox]] announces that [[Utah]] will offer K95 and [[Mechanical filter (respirator)|KN95 masks]] to students during the fall semester. [https://www.abc4.com/coronavirus/kn95-masks-to-be-offered-to-students-this-school-year-says-utah-governor/ (KTVX)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://greekcitytimes.com/2021/08/04/covid-19-3428-new-cases-greece/amp/ (''Greek City Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****[[Scotland|Scottish]] [[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]] announces that the legal requirement for [[social distancing]] in Scotland will be removed on August 9 and the blanket 10-day self-isolation for school pupils will also be ended in order to prevent educational disruption, as long as all pupils test negative. However, [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|face covering]]s will be mandatory for secondary school students and staff for the first six weeks of the new term. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/aug/03/scotland-scrap-social-distancing-plan-lift-most-covid-rules (''The Guardian'')]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 138 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day death toll since March 17. [https://www.itv.com/news/2021-08-03/uk-records-highest-daily-covid-death-toll-since-mid-march (''ITV News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
***[[Morocco]] extends its nightly curfew nationwide to from 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. and restricts the operation of all businesses and tourist hubs in [[Casablanca]], [[Agadir]] and [[Marrakesh]] to essential travel and those who have been [[COVID-19 vaccination in Morocco|vaccinated]] in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/morocco-announces-national-curfew-effective-tuesday-tweet-2021-08-02/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Solomon Islands]]
***The [[Solomon Islands]] indefinitely closes its borders in an attempt to prevent the Delta variant from entering the country. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/448351/solomons-shutdown-borders-to-keep-delta-variant-out (RNZ International)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict]]
**Saudi foreign minister [[Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud]] says that he "sees an emboldened [[Iran]] acting in a negative manner around the Middle East, endangering shipping, arming the [[Houthis]] and contributing to a political deadlock in [[Lebanon]]". Al Saud further stated that Saudi Arabia supports any talks with Iran "as long as it ensures that Iran will not now nor ever get nuclear weapons". [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-arabia-sees-emboldened-iran-around-middle-east-2021-08-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Belarus at the 2020 Summer Olympics]]
**Sprinter [[Krystsina Tsimanouskaya]] loses a bid to continue competing in the games as she was granted a humanitarian visa by [[Poland]] while the [[International Olympic Committee]] begins an investigation. Tsimanouskaya, who refused to fly back to [[Belarus]], entered the Polish embassy in [[Tokyo]] on Sunday and requested temporary asylum in Japan. Japanese foreign minister [[Toshimitsu Motegi]] assured Tsimanouskaya that Japan had taken measures to protect her. [https://www.dw.com/en/olympic-organizers-probe-case-of-belarusian-sprinter/a-58737335 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Andrew Cuomo sexual harassment allegations]]
**A report released by [[Attorney General of New York|New York Attorney General]] [[Letitia James]] says that [[Governor of New York|Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] sexually harassed 11 women. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/cuomo-sexually-harassed-multiple-women-including-employees-new-york-attorney-n1275806 (NBC News)]
*A [[United States Pentagon Police|Pentagon police officer]] is fatally stabbed in an apparently random attack outside [[the Pentagon]] building. The attacker then fatally shoots himself with the officer's weapon, while a civilian bystander is wounded. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pentagon-lockdown-shooting/ (CBS News)]
*A court in Russia sentences [[Lyubov Sobol]], an ally of [[Alexei Navalny]], to eighteen months of parole-like restrictions after finding her guilty of violations of [[COVID-19_pandemic_in_Russia#Lockdowns|COVID-19 restrictions]]. She rejects the convictions, calling them politically motivated and nonsense. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-finds-navalny-ally-sobol-guilty-breaching-covid-19-health-rules-2021-08-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*Amid an unprecedented [[heatwave]], [[Greece]] records its highest-ever temperature of 46.3°C (115.3 °F) in [[Makrakomi]], [[Phthiotis]], according to the [[National Observatory of Athens]]. [https://greekreporter.com/2021/08/03/greece-heatwave-records-highest-temperature-in-its-history/ (Greek Reporter)]
